description: This Java class defines a global exception handler for a Spring Boot application, mapping application-specific and generic exceptions to HTTP responses with appropriate status codes and detailed problem descriptions.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring Boot RestControllerAdvice class that handles exceptions globally across the application, converting them into standardized HTTP ProblemDetails responses.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles NotFoundException and returns a 404 ProblemDetail response with a specific type, title, and detail message.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation exceptions, returns a 400 ProblemDetail response with validation error details.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles all other exceptions, returning a 500 ProblemDetail response indicating an internal server error.
